opportunities.title: Regular Grants (under £100,000)

amount.raw: Regular Grant – under £100,000. For operating/core costs, support is generally around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; capital/project grants tend to be approximately 10-20% of costs (local community capital projects typically no greater than £30,000).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and organisations exempt/excepted under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return). Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities. One application at a time; must wait a year after a previous decision.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, and projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Covers arts, community, education, environment, faith, health, museums and heritage, welfare, and youth sectors.

opportunities.title: Major Grants (£100,000 and over)

amount.raw: Major Grant – £100,000 and over. Considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisation must either have an annual income of over £1 million (for core cost grants), or total project/capital costs must be at least £1 million. Must be a UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation with at least one year's accounts. Eligible organisations in arts, community, education, environment, faith, health, museums and heritage, welfare, and youth sectors.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over for capital or project costs (project total at least £1 million) or core costs (organisation annual income at least £1 million). Apply via an Expression of Interest form, which can be submitted all year round with no deadlines; reviewed on a rolling basis and considered at one of eight Board meetings per year.
